intro.lead: Training, tests and field records for ICDS health workers: video lessons and a test for each training phase, and a register of the mothers and babies each worker follows up, with growth checks against WHO standards.

worker.title: Health workers
worker.body: Watch the training videos, take the tests, register mothers, and record each baby's weight, length and feeding on home visits.

monitor.title: Batch monitors
monitor.body: See which workers in the batch have late visits or missing forms, and follow up by phone or WhatsApp.

district.title: Programme teams
district.body: Follow training and adoptions district by district, find babies who are not growing well, run tests and export the records.

footer.note: For ICDS programme staff and health workers.
